title: Where does the energy go while AI produces an answer?
summary: A small code edit can conceal a long sequence of reading, searching, testing and failed attempts. A thermodynamic study of coding agents opens a way to examine information processing alongside measured energy use. Decisions about what to remember, when to compute further and when to stop shape both the reliability of the results and their environmental burden.
